fix: At the boundary, for each cycle above the wave median of LLM minutes to verdict or with a fail-fast ratio under a policy threshold, score each side index in minutes and name the top blocker with its evidence. Record it in the cycle result and pass a repeating blocker (same fingerprint in 2 or more cycles) to the X12 incident detector.

summary: When a cycle does not fail fast or deliver fast, something blocks the pipeline. The side indexes exist but nothing reads them per cycle: wall time against LLM time per phase, corrections and floor rejections, audit rounds, context fill and cache-read growth, continuation stamp and adoption, quota exits (85), ship rebase signals, deadline stops, and a repeating failure fingerprint across cycles.
title: A slow or late-failing cycle names its top blocker from the side indexes and feeds the incident detector
